controls.query:

| WHERE host.name == "db-1" AND @timestamp >= "2026-07-06T20:02:30.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-06T21:02:30.000Z"
| KEEP message, user.name, host.name, @timestamp, log.level, postgresql.log.database
| LIMIT 5
